command: cargo run --release -p mb-analysis --example vocal_score -- score  (MB_ORACLE=oracle-b for the second fixture; MB_THREADS, default 4)
stages_vs_rekordbox: bit-identical to rekordbox's VocalDetector (native harness): filter tables, power frames, mel, fluctogram, features, normalised features, probabilities
runtime_inputs: vd_param_raw.pb (plain GraphDef, MD5-checked) and three MD5-checked regions of the installed rekordbox executable (normalisation statistics, Chebyshev window); nothing copied into the repo
seconds_per_track: about 1 (decode + vocal pass, 4 tracks in parallel)
